name: wildcard-permitted-inner-valid
description: A wildcard SAN whose expansions are entirely inside the permitted DNS subtree must be accepted: *.foo.example.com only expands to names under foo.example.com.
references: Go name_constraints_test "inner wildcard names are matched by subdomain permitted constraints"
notes: RFC 5280 does not define wildcard SAN semantics; this targets Go's application DNS-ID name-constraint behavior.
